$comment: Source schema for the OWASP Threat Model Library CycloneDX 2.0 profile. The CycloneDX models it references come from the specification fork pinned in build-schema.sh; run that script to regenerate the bundled schema. Do not edit the bundled file by hand.
title: OWASP Threat Model Library CycloneDX 2.0 Schema
description: A CycloneDX 2.0 profile for OWASP Threat Model Library documents. It is CycloneDX 2.0 plus rules that require every element threat-model.schema.json requires, so any valid document converts back to the library format without loss. See cyclonedx/README.md and scripts/cyclonedx_convert.py.

specFormat.title: Specification Format
specFormat.description: Specifies the format. This value shall be CycloneDX.

specVersion.title: Specification Version
specVersion.description: The version of the CycloneDX specification the threat model conforms to.

serialNumber.title: BOM Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Unique identifier for this threat-model BOM.

version.title: BOM Version
version.description: Revision number for this threat-model BOM.

metadata.description: Threat-model metadata. At least one tool component is required.

threats.description: Threats, one scenario per threat (holding its persona and event), and the CAPEC attack patterns they use.

blueprints.description: Exactly one blueprint, holding the threat model's architecture and data flows.

scope.description: Scope of the threat model. Its classification has no CycloneDX field yet, so it is held in properties.

relationship.description: Either a component containing other components, or a control listing the threats it mitigates.

blueprint.description: The single blueprint holding the threat model's architecture. Everything the OWASP Threat Model Library requires is required here.

threat.description: A threat. Its persona and triggering event live on the matching scenario.
